title: Sometimes you don’t see it yet… But God is already fighting battles you don’t even know are coming.
paragraphs:
Sometimes you don’t see it yet…
But God is already fighting battles you don’t even know are coming.
The path is lit before you — all you need to do is step forward.
🔥✨

Trust the God who goes before you.
What you’re praying for… He’s already preparing. 🙏✨

Deuteronomy 31:8 (NIV)
“The Lord himself goes before you and will be with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged.”
